target_customer: B2B software companies whose prospects, new users and support teams need product demos
problem: Prospects want to see the product at peak interest but sales teams cannot staff live demos 24/7; Karumi joins a live video call and demos the real product.
product_category: AI demo agent for sales and onboarding

founders.name: Pablo Omenaca
founders.background_notes: Founding engineer and COO at StackAI per the YC page.

founders.name: Toni Lopez
previous_startups: Describes himself as having founded three companies; names not given
founders.background_notes: Founding engineer at StackAI and software developer at IBM Research per the YC page.

competitors.name: Fluidworks
competitors.what: Live video agent for SaaS sales demos

technical_complexity.rationale: Combining live video avatar, speech, and a browser agent that navigates a real product reliably in any language is demanding, but built from existing voice, video and computer use APIs.

defensibility.rationale: Components are widely available and several similar products exist; no data or network effect advantage shown.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitors in live video demo agents existed before and around the batch (Naoma and others launched or marketed later per vendor posts). No acquisition of Karumi found.

market_need_then: Companies were adding AI agents to sales in 2025. Karumi said it ran 3,000 plus demos of its own product in the week after its YC launch (company reported, per a search summary).

branding.domain_note: Uses karumi.ai; no purchase story found.

identity.logo: Not described by any source found
identity.visual_style: Bold key words in headlines, concise benefit copy
identity.voice_and_tone: Punchy, for example Don't show your product like it's 1995

branding.brand_signature: Tagline The Waymo of Personalized demos (YC listing) and the 1995 line on the site
branding.community_and_virality: Launched on Product Hunt on 2025-11-20 and on Hacker News; a competitor comparison post by Naoma discusses it.

brand_strength.rationale: A short invented name with a punchy voice and a launch spike, but a competitor post notes only a single G2 review and no wider press about the brand.

outcome_analysis: Karumi is active and early with a six person team led by two StackAI alumni. It launched in November 2025 with a demo spike and has several live video demo competitors. No outcome news or confirmed funding beyond a reported YC check was found, so the story is too early to read.
notes: Unverified funding: Caplight lists $500K total and Naoma's comparison post says $500K from YC; StartupHub's $2M pre-seed is an estimate that conflicts. No round recorded. Competitor list has one dated entry; others found were undated vendor posts. MIT for Pablo Omenaca comes from the YC page. Naoma post is a competitor's marketing. The recorded round (500K from YC, the standard deal, dated by the Nordic9 item of 2025-10-01) rests on a single outlet; Caplight lists a seed dated Sep 29, 2025 without an amount. The StartupHub 2M pre-seed estimate conflicts and is not recorded.
